findings.current: Even if they split their forces and attacked three cities at once,
findings.defect: 성 refers to provinces here, not cities.
findings.rationale: The calculation concerns an army threatening multiple provinces.
findings.replacement: Even if they split their forces and attacked three provinces at once,
findings.source: 설령 놈들이 병력을 분산시켜 세 개의 성을 동시에 노린다고 하더라도

findings.current: A month and a half ago, I issued an emergency call to all the Murim factions in Gansu.
findings.defect: 달포 means roughly a month, not a month and a half; 비상을 내리다 means putting them on alert, not merely calling for them.
findings.rationale: The source specifies an approximate month and an alert preceding the rapid mobilization.
findings.replacement: About a month ago, I put all of Gansu Murim on alert.
findings.source: 달포 전, 감숙 무림 전체에 비상을 내렸네.

findings.current: The greatest obstacle was, in the end, the numbers.
findings.defect: The draft omits which side has the numerical disadvantage.
findings.rationale: 수적열세 explicitly identifies the defenders as outnumbered.
findings.replacement: The greatest obstacle, in the end, was that we were outnumbered.

findings.current: If a Great Nation had watched on while this many ruffians—who might turn the blades at their waists against one another at any moment—gathered, would it have stood by?
findings.defect: The draft makes the ruffians liable to attack one another, undermining the stated reason the government would intervene.
findings.rationale: The surrounding explanation says the state tolerates Murim only while its own foundations remain secure.
findings.replacement: Would the Great Nation have stood idly by if this many ruffians, liable to turn the swords at their waists against the state at any moment, had gathered?
findings.source: 언제 허리춤에 찬 칼을 거꾸로 휘두를지 모르는 파락호들이 이리 많다면, 대국(大國)에서 가만히 두고 보았겠습니까.

findings.current: He’s even staked his life on it. How could that not be deeply troubling?
findings.defect: “Deeply troubling” suggests his pledge raises concern; the speaker laments that a trusted comrade has had to stake his life.
findings.rationale: 통탄할 노릇 condemns the situation, following the speaker’s affirmation of Sima Gong’s character.
findings.replacement: That a man like him should have to stake his life on this—isn’t that a crying shame?
findings.source: 그런 이가 목숨까지 걸었으니, 이것이야말로 실로 통탄할 노릇이 아니겠습니까.

findings.current: Unorthodox, dark path. I don’t give a damn where they crawled out of or whether they’re dog bones.
findings.defect: “Dog bones” reads as literal objects rather than Jeok Cheongang’s contemptuous description of worthless nobodies.
findings.rationale: 개뼉다귀 is an insult directed at people; the line lists groups Jeok is willing to accept.
findings.replacement: Unorthodox, dark-path figures, or nobodies who crawled in from God knows where—I don’t give a damn.
findings.source: 사파건, 흑도건. 어디서 굴러먹다 왔는지 모를 개뼉다귀 건  아무래도 상관없다.

summary: Several consequential errors change the timeline, the scale of the threat, and the reason the government would intervene. One response also reverses the intended emotional judgment.
